title: Who you're becoming
subtitle: You write this. It grows as you do, and it's never finished. Nothing here needs an AI key.

northStar.label: North star
northStar.empty: One sentence for the direction you're heading.

identity.label: A few words
identity.empty: Words for who you are right now. They can change.

goals.label: Goals
goals.empty: Something you're moving toward. A goal doesn't get a score.
goals.linkHint: Optional. A linked goal shows what your record says, never a percentage.
goals.evidenceTracked: {{name}} · tracked on {{done}} of the last {{active}} days
goals.evidenceQuiet: {{name}} · not due in the last 7 days
goals.missingHabit: This habit isn't on this device.
goals.missingGroup: This group isn't on this device.
goals.uncounted: {{name}} isn't counted as done or missed.

knowledge.label: Knowledge map
knowledge.promptHint: A note to yourself. It isn't a chat, and it isn't sent anywhere.
knowledge.answerPlaceholder: I've been trying to read before bed…
knowledge.empty: Nothing here yet. Add a note whenever you want.

aside.label: Set aside
aside.hint: Still here. Nothing on this page is finished.

deleted.label: Deleted
deleted.confirmMessage: “{{name}}” leaves the compass and stays in Deleted, where you can bring it back.

errors.too_long: That's longer than this field can hold.
errors.link_conflict: Link a habit or a group, not both.
